```{=html}
<script>
// Progressive enhancement for the theme filter: Quarto's listing script does the filtering
// (it wires every .quarto-listing-category .category); this only reveals the bar when JS runs
// and mirrors Quarto's .active class into aria-pressed for assistive technology.
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const bar = document.querySelector(".rr-theme-filter");
  if (!bar) return;
  const buttons = [...bar.querySelectorAll(".category")];
  const sync = () => {
    if (!buttons.some((b) => b.classList.contains("active"))) buttons[0].classList.add("active");
    buttons.forEach((b) => b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b.classList.contains("active"))));
  };
  new MutationObserver(sync).observe(bar, { subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["class"] });
  bar.hidden = false;
  sync();
});
</script>
```
